records.name: Milo Checkin
records.biography_en: Milo Checkin serves with the Care Detail of The Quiet Ward. The kit includes a small blank intake slate with teal corner protectors. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Milo Checkin treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
